SiteMetrics.title: SiteMetrics
SiteMetrics.description: Global persistent counter and analytics tracking student visits

totalVisits.description: Cumulative total number of legitimate visits recorded across all sessions

uniqueVisitors.description: Total count of unique individual learners/devices

todayVisits.description: Count of visits recorded on the current calendar day

lastVisitDate.description: Current date in YYYY-MM-DD format for daily resets

lastVisitTimestamp.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent visit event

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the metric document was last synchronized

VisitorLog.title: VisitorLog
VisitorLog.description: Record of an individual student or tester session

firstSeenAt.description: ISO timestamp when the visitor first entered

lastSeenAt.description: ISO timestamp of the latest interaction

visitCount.description: Number of recorded visits by this visitor

isCreator.description: Flag indicating if the session belongs to creator mode

/site_metrics/{metricId}.description: Global visitor metrics documents readable by all visitors and updatable on legitimate visits

/visitors/{visitorId}.description: Individual visitor session records tracking unique student devices
